# The Middle of the Square

*Tinder wants to play one big show right in the middle of Lantern Square, the biggest in years. Ask Jinx to warm up the crowd and keep it back, and tell Ivo the first coins of the night are his.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Urbanograd](../towns/urbanograd_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Tinder](../npcs/tinder.md) |
| Level | 30 |
| After | [Lamp Oil](../quests/tinder_lamp_oil.md) |

## Objectives

1. Talk to [Jinx](../npcs/jinx.md)
2. Talk to [Ivo Sable](../npcs/ivo_sable.md)

- 4,580 EXP

    - I've had an idea, and it frightens me, which is how I know it's a good one. One show. The whole of Lantern Square. Not off to the side. Dead centre, under the first string of lanterns, on a good night when everyone's out.
    - The new oil burns clean enough for it now. But a crowd that size leans in. I need someone working the edge, keeping them back and laughing. And I need Ivo to know what's coming. He always gets the first coins of a good night. Always.
    - Ask [Jinx](../npcs/jinx.md) to warm them up and hold the edge, friend. Then go to [Ivo Sable](../npcs/ivo_sable.md) under the green awning and tell him the first coins are his. I'd do it myself, but if I go round asking, I'll lose my nerve.
    - Jinx is wherever the noise is. Ivo's under the patched green awning on the edge of the square. Go on, before I check the bucket again.
    - (Visibly relieved and disappointed at once.) Another night, then. The side of the square is very nice. Very safe.
    - Jinx, to hold the crowd. Ivo, for the first coins. Then the middle of the square is mine.
    - Tinder wants ME to warm up the crowd? For the big one? In the MIDDLE? Yes! Yes yes yes. I'll juggle the bouncy ones round the edge, everyone will step back to catch them, nobody gets singed.
    - Tell Tinder I'll keep them back a whole arm's length. Two arms. Mine are long. And tell Tinder I won't touch the torches. I promise. I'll want to. I won't.
    - The middle of the square? Well, good for her. (Ivo puts down the bandage he is rolling.) Tinder's given me the first coins of every good night since she stayed here. I've never once asked her to. I keep them in a tin for the salve-money.
    - Tell her I'll be right here under the awning with the burn salve, the same as always, and I fully expect not to need it, the same as always. And tell her to breathe out slowly. That's the singer in me talking.
